justification: Image A depicts a symmetrical relief scene with two winged human-headed figures flanking a stylized tree/palmette motif, rendered in low relief with fine linear detail and an inscription band below, in a naturalistic-schematic figural style. Image B depicts a single, monumental humanoid figure with an elongated head, stylized hair or headdress, and abstract carved motifs on the torso (circle, banded shapes), carved in the round with heavy, blocky proportions; there is no shared iconographic motif, composition, or figural convention between the two, only the generic fact that both show carved imagery involving human-like forms.
